requirement_match.summary: Approved v1 registration, simulated commands, safe scheduled jobs and immutable artifact contracts were reviewed against source.

security.summary: No global force, deletion bypass, secret payload access, dependency change or client mode authority was introduced. Null admission rejects before writes.

code_quality.summary: Node 22, TypeScript 6 and Firebase v2 source pass backend strict, lint, 258 focused unit cases and 124 artifact/SDK contracts.

failure_paths.summary: Invalid runtime/policy, replay, malformed provenance, unsupported financial/physical actions, guard escape, dotenv/source mismatch and scheduler recovery races are covered.

error_handling.summary: An existing customer-safe generic message is reused with a new internal reason. Projection failures log a constant without PII and remain eligible on future wrap or creation-trigger retry.

trade_offs.summary: The fixed two-flag public dotenv ZIP exception is digest-bound and substituted by per-function runtime environment readback. Legacy artifacts preserve their existing holds and exclusions.

production_readiness.summary: Full combined build, CI, artifact, provider readback, activation and live acceptance remain outside child ownership. Production is NOT_READY.

product_language.summary: Owned release files introduce no new user-facing copy. Backend provenance feeds UI meaning, so the root aggregate product review remains required.

review_cycles.finding: The first artifact aggregate failed 19 offline fixture lock-resolution calls. No security, lock or audit gate was relaxed. A fresh unchanged rerun passed 124/124; historical retry-only 106/106 evidence remains separate.

The canonical five-demo fixture was stale after approved SePay registration. It now checks three retained authentic handlers and two excluded client-outcome demo handlers. The 199 preflight cases pass within the current 258-case run.

Recovery could repeatedly scan the same 30 legacy/noncustomer jobs. Fixed with a private round-robin cursor and transactional compare-and-set; mixed-head, wrap, projection failure and overlap cases pass.

Generic submitRequest could fall through to live creation when test admission was missing. Artifact v1 now fails closed, including malformed runtime identity. Ten actual-producer scenarios cover zero-write negatives, provenance, replay after policy-off and legacy compatibility.

No known actionable defect remains in the reviewed owned source within executed checks. Aggregate release review remains BLOCKED pending root-owned build, CI, artifact, provider, live and product review.

residual_risks: The normal combined build must regenerate public-assets; actual source preflight currently fails PUBLIC_ASSET_BINDING_INVALID as expected.
Whole combined unit/rules/HTTP/audit/artifact/provider readback and post-activation live acceptance remain root-owned and NOT_RUN here.

Recovery scans at most 30 outbox rows per run, plus policy/cursor reads and bounded projection transactions, with at most five projections running together. Sustained backlog latency has not been benchmarked; the retry-enabled creation trigger remains the primary recovery path.
Ask feedback cleanup remains held until index deployment and READY readback are implemented and reviewed.
Actual SePay secret version and endpoint/provider IPN acceptance must be verified without agents reading secret payloads.
Root must reconcile clean main c423001 retry repair with this 608-based working tree before the final combined commit.
limitations: RIG is DEGRADED; evidence is bounded source, CLI, compiler and contract checks rather than a fresh whole-program index.

The actual-command unit executes the verbatim index.ts command declaration with real domain/auth/policy and Firebase callable .run; storage is a mocked atomic transaction. This is not live HTTP, AppCheck or MFA proof.
SDK artifact discovery uses real constructors/imports with zero network access; it is not provider payment acceptance.
The ai-agent-kit executable is absent. Hash-bound file receipts are preserved; the runtime ledger/report adapter was unavailable.
